summary: Verified admin red order-notification badge X-dismiss + persistence bug fix on preview URL. All 4 requested scenarios PASSED: (A) badge + X button render for admin with last_seen=0; (B) initial localStorage values are '0'; (C) clicking dismiss X removes the wrapper from DOM; (D) localStorage 'admin_customer_orders_last_seen_ms' and 'admin_b2b_orders_last_seen_ms' updated to large ms timestamps (e.g. 1786357852234); (E) after page reload the badge does NOT reappear (persistence confirmed); (F) clicking the badge body (after resetting last_seen) still navigates to /admin — existing behavior preserved.

issues: Minor: The dismiss X button uses absolute '-top-2 -right-2' positioning which pushes it partially outside its parent container's bounding box. Playwright's regular .click() timed out on it (dispatch_event('click') worked). Real users on desktop can still click it (bbox at x=1884, width=24 within 1920 viewport), but on narrow viewports the X could be clipped by the viewport edge or by parent overflow. Consider adding some padding/margin to the wrapper or using inset positioning inside the badge so the X sits within the visible/interactive area.

action_items: Optional: reposition the X dismiss button so it is fully inside the red badge boundary (or add wrapper padding) to avoid hit-test edge cases on narrow viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix implementation is correct and works end-to-end. Firestore snapshot listeners return quickly enough (badge appears within ~5-7s after deferred 3s mount).
Persistence via localStorage keys 'admin_customer_orders_last_seen_ms' and 'admin_b2b_orders_last_seen_ms' correctly set to Date.now() on dismiss; on reload the count comparison keeps badge hidden.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing customer_orders in Firestore (>=1 qualifying order was present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The AdminGlobalNotifications component is mounted globally via App.tsx with DeferredMount delayMs=3000. To simulate an admin, set localStorage keys before reload: userRole=admin, userId=test-admin, and reset last_seen keys to '0'. Wait ~5-8s for Firestore snapshot to populate. Header B2B broadcast modal was NOT tested (requires real Firebase admin auth per request).
